mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI YoY growth > 2.5% does not correlate with tighter monetary policy.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which leads to increased corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or UNRATE < 4% does not correlate with increased corporate earnings.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% MoM signals increased economic activity and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or HOUST MoM growth > 5% does not correlate with increased economic activity.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals increased economic output and corporate profitability, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO MoM growth > 1% does not correlate with increased economic output.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals robust consumer demand and labor market strength, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS MoM growth > 0.5% and UNRATE MoM decline > 0.1%
regime_hint: strong consumer demand and labor market
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint condition does not correlate with increased economic activity.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or PAYEMS MoM decline > 100,000 does not correlate with weakening labor market conditions.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in real GDP (GDPC1) signals strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in periods of strong GDP growth are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
